title: Use Claude for free - tips & hacks #claude #ai
description:
Learn how to use Claude for free and get the most out of the Sonnet model without a subscription.

This guide breaks down exactly how to leverage Claude's file upload features and context window for your daily tasks. We cover how the free version manages token usage so you can keep working without hitting limits unexpectedly.
